scientific_integrity: Proof and reproducibility program included; finite enumeration corroborates but cannot replace general proof. Literature-priority uncertainty remains. No independent external validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Two colors, complete multipartite graphs with at least three equally sized parts and at least two vertices in each part, fixed population, monotone own-color fraction utility, and strictly bilateral profitable exchanges. Exact path-length distribution requires two vertices per part; no heterogeneous parts, vacancy, or nonlinear preference extensions are claimed.
title: Welfare-optimal swap equilibria and an exact convergence clock on equal-part networks
